subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The science of teaching
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Pedagogy"** refers to the method and practice of teaching, especially as an academic subject or theoretical concept. (शिक्षाशास्त्र)

 
 
• **Example: **The university offers a course in** pedagogy **for those interested in becoming teachers.
 
 
 
• Hence, the term that accurately describes the science of teaching is **'Pedagogy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Pedagogy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Technology **(प्रौद्योगिकी): Application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes, especially in industry.

 
 
• **Example:** The latest technology in smartphones has made them indispensable tools for communication and entertainment.
 
 
 
• **Astrology **(ज्योतिष): The study of the movements and relative positions of celestial bodies interpreted as having an influence on human affairs and the natural world.
 
 
• **Example: **Many people consult astrology to make decisions about their future.
 
 
 
• **Zoology** (प्राणिविज्ञान): The scientific study of the behavior, structure, physiology, classification, and distribution of animals.
 
 
• **Example:** She has a degree in zoology and works as a wildlife biologist.
